metadata.journal_name: Harvard Civil Rights-Civil Liberties Law Review

navigation.pagination: none - /archive/ lists the complete run on a single page; /archive/page/2/ returns identical content (verified: 0 new items), so a pager walk would loop rather than paginate
navigation.notes: Journal moved off harvardcrcl.org, which now sits entirely behind HTTP Basic auth (WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="Restricted Area"; 401 on every path including robots.txt). The live home is the Harvard journals WordPress multisite at /crcl/ (site id 80). The 2026-08-29 Harvard gather covered ilj, jol and lpr only, so CR-CL had never been collected. robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 10 - run with a large MIN_DELAY. Article PDFs are same-origin under /crcl/wp-content/uploads/sites/80/<YYYY>/<MM>/.
